scripts.test: npm run build && node --test lib/*.test.js lib/notifications/*.test.js
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions --project sporta-unconfigured
scripts.test:emulators: npm run build && cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --project demo-classcard-notifications --only firestore,auth "npm --prefix classcard-functions run test:integration"
